description: This PHP file defines a class ViewConnectorSettings that extends SugarView and manages the display of the connector settings page within the SuiteCRM administration module. It includes methods for retrieving module title parameters, the active module tab, and rendering the view with assigned template variables. The file also contains license and copyright comments.

classes.name: ViewConnectorSettings
classes.description: A controller class for the Connector Settings view within the SuiteCRM admin module, responsible for rendering the configuration page.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the title parameters for the module, including a link to the administration index.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the name of the active module tab, in this case 'Administration'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the connector settings page by assigning template variables and displaying the Smarty template.
